d: Far-future solar and deep-space hard science fiction novels by astrophysicist Alastair Reynolds.

gliese-667-c.x: Temperate colony planet orbiting the red dwarf Gliese 667 C, destination of the generation ship flotillas where humans encounter the enigmatic Mandala artifacts.

saturn.x: Saturnian moon revealed to be an ancient camouflaged interstellar vehicle that suddenly ignites and accelerates out of the Solar System.

hip-65474.x: Massive artificial megastructure near Spica where the moonship Janus arrives across cosmic distances to encounter diverse interstellar civilizations.

moon.x: Lunar headquarters and vast underground installations of the Akinya family industrial empire in Blue Remembered Earth.

b.s: Key settings from Alastair Reynolds’s Poseidon’s Children trilogy across the Akinya family saga to Gliese 667 C, and the rogue moonship Janus heading for Spica in Pushing Ice.
